marrs.title: Coral Reef Soundscapes from a Global Restoration Programme
marrs.verification_note: The figshare dataset record itself registers 2 authors (Ben Williams, Kate Jones). The related bioRxiv study paper (10.1101/2025.09.24.678197) lists the full 16-name author list — Williams, B.; Mars Coral Restoration Project Monitoring Team; Naseem, A.; Nava, G.; Roberts, A.; Nicholson, F.; du Luart, A.; Erasmus, D.; Stoole, O.; Whittick, A.; Gibb, R.; Razak, T.B.; Lamont, T.A.C.; Simpson, S.D.; Curnick, D.J.; Jones, K.E. — confirmed live via the bioRxiv API this session. Do not attribute the full paper author list to the dataset record; they are different registry entities.

sanctsound.title: Sanctuary Soundscape Monitoring Project (SanctSound)
authors: NOAA Office of National Marine Sanctuaries
sanctsound.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
sanctsound.verification_note: SanctSound issues per-site, per-detection-type DOIs at NCEI (e.g. 10.25921/PF0H-SQ72) rather than one collection-level DOI — confirmed live this session against the NCEI passive-acoustic-data page. No single DOI exists for the project as a whole, so doi is recorded null and the project landing page is used as the canonical url. Underlying archive filenames (NOAA-Navy-SanctSound_*) show the U.S. Navy as a co-contributing data partner alongside NOAA ONMS.
